description: This Java source file defines a class named 'SkipBaseSetupAnnotationExecutionListener' which extends Spring's 'AbstractTestExecutionListener'. Its purpose is to listen to test execution events, specifically to check for the presence of the '@SkipBaseSetup' annotation on test methods or classes, and to conditionally skip the base setup process in test cases within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: SkipBaseSetupAnnotationExecutionListener
classes.description: A test execution listener for selectively skipping base setup in tests based on annotations.

methods.name: beforeTestMethod
methods.description: Executed before each test method; checks for '@SkipBaseSetup' annotation and skips setup if present.

methods.name: callMethod
methods.description: Utility method that invokes a named method via reflection on the current test class.
